knowledge:
- key_parameters: DUPLICATETHRESHOLD=threshold for PCR duplicate filtering (e.g., 1 to remove read-pairs with both ends mapping to identical coordinates) ;; res=resolution/bin size in base pairs (e.g., 1000000) ;; BSgenomeName=the character string name of the BSgenome package used for mapping ;; genome=the actual BSgenome object corresponding to the genome of interest ;; restrictionSite=the restriction site sequence with cleavage site marked by ^ (e.g., "A^AGCTT") ;; enzyme=the name of the restriction enzyme used (e.g., "HindIII") ;; cistrans=defines whether to detect "all", "cis", or "trans" interactions ;; filterdist=minimum distance in base pairs to filter out self-ligations and adjacent fragments (typically 10000) ;; restrictionFile=path to the restriction fragment file required for the HiCUP-specific workflow
- alternatives: HiCUP can be used as an external preprocessing tool to filter invalid read-pairs and remove duplicates before running GOTHiChicup ;; Bowtie is used for initial alignment of raw reads before pairing with pairReads
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing genome-wide Hi-C datasets to identify statistically significant long-range chromatin interactions while correcting for systematic biases (such as restriction site density, GC content, and mappability) using a cumulative binomial test.
- pitfalls: Poor quality experiments can result in a uniform p-value distribution (0 to 1) rather than a sharp peak near 0 ;; Low coverage samples can show a bimodal p-value distribution and yield very few significant interactions ;; Self-ligations and adjacent fragments must be filtered out (typically using a 10kb threshold via filterdist) to avoid false positives.

workflows.name: standard_gothic_pipeline
workflows.intent: Identify significant genomic interactions from raw aligned paired-end reads (Bowtie output) using the standard GOTHiC pipeline.
workflows.stages: 1. Pair aligned reads using pairReads ;; 2. Map paired reads to restriction sites using mapReadsToRestrictionSites ;; 3. Run the full binomial test pipeline using GOTHiC
workflows.code:
dirPath = system.file("extdata", package="HiCDataLymphoblast")
fileName1 = list.files(dirPath, full.names=TRUE)[1]
fileName2 = list.files(dirPath, full.names=TRUE)[2]
paired = pairReads(fileName1, fileName2, sampleName="lymphoid_chr20", 
DUPLICATETHRESHOLD = 1, fileType="Table")

data(lymphoid_chr20_paired_filtered)
mapped=mapReadsToRestrictionSites(filtered, sampleName="lymphoid_chr20", 
BSgenomeName="BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg18", 
genome=BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg18, 
restrictionSite="A^AGCTT", enzyme="HindIII", parallel=FALSE, cores=1)

binom=GOTHiC(fileName1,fileName2, sampleName="lymphoid_chr20", 
res=1000000, BSgenomeName="BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg18",
genome=BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg18, 
restrictionSite="A^AGCTT", enzyme="HindIII" ,cistrans="all", filterdist=10000,
DUPLICATETHRESHOLD=1, fileType="Table", parallel=FALSE, cores=NULL)

workflows.name: hicup_gothic_pipeline
workflows.intent: Identify significant genomic interactions from HiCUP preprocessed and filtered BAM/SAM files using GOTHiChicup.
workflows.stages: 1. Run the binomial test on HiCUP output using GOTHiChicup
workflows.code:
dirPath <- system.file("extdata", package="HiCDataLymphoblast")
fileName <- list.files(dirPath, full.names=TRUE)[4]
restrictionFile <- list.files(dirPath, full.names=TRUE)[3]
binom=GOTHiChicup(fileName, sampleName='lymphoid_chr20', res=1000000, 
restrictionFile, cistrans='all', parallel=FALSE, cores=NULL)
